integrity: Two exact standalone full-Fourier enumerations and an all-order analytic proof; finite checks are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only connected simple graphs whose blocks are K2 or K3, finite abelian palettes of size at least three, and unnormalized proper-colouring counting convolution. No guarantee for longer cycles or larger cliques; historical equivalence risk from multivariate Potts expansions and unindexed computations.
title: Complete Fourier recovery on triangular block graphs
